about: What's new, shown once after an update (tutorial.js). Newest first. v = the version number the change went live in; lines = one or two short sentences a player understands. The Visuals session adds an entry at each merge: v is the version on the default branch before the merge, plus 1.

lines: Tours: each tab explains itself the first time you open it. Tap ? to see a tour again.
ICEYfish remembers where you were: your tab, deck, settings and Practice game survive a reload.
Duel and Pod: everyone rolls a d20 to see who goes first.
Melded cards come together with an animation.
